To oversee and review the reform proposals, Prime Minister Shehbaz ordered the establishment of a dedicated committee composed of federal ministers Mohsin Naqvi, Azam Nazeer Tarar, Muhammad Aurangzeb, and Shaza Fatima Khawaja. The committee has been directed to finalize and submit its comprehensive recommendations to the prime minister before the end of the current week.

The high-level meeting was attended by several key federal ministers, including Azam Nazeer Tarar, Musadik Masood Malik, Ahad Khan Cheema, Muhammad Aurangzeb, and Syed Mohsin Raza Naqvi. Ministers of State Talal Chaudhry and Bilal Azhar Kayani were also present alongside senior officers from various relevant government departments.

stories.title: محمد ذیشان علی کی خلا میں تاریخی پرواز، چین کے خلائی اسٹیشن پہنچ گئے
stories.summary:
پاکستان کے پہلے خلاباز محمد ذیشان علی نے شین ژو 24 مشن کے تحت خلا کا کامیاب سفر کیا ہے اور وہ چین کے تیان گونگ خلائی اسٹیشن پر پہنچنے والے پہلے غیر ملکی خلاباز بن گئے ہیں۔ یہ تاریخی مشن جیو چھوان خلائی مرکز سے لانگ مارچ ٹو ایف راکٹ کے ذریعے روانہ کیا گیا۔

خلائی جہاز نے خودکار نظام کے تحت تیان گونگ کے مرکزی ماڈیول تیان ہی کے ساتھ کامیابی سے رابطہ قائم کیا جس میں چینی خلاباز تانگ ہونگبو اور وو یی بھی شامل تھے۔ اس سفر میں لانچنگ سے لے کر خلائی اسٹیشن تک پہنچنے کا عمل تقریباً پانچ گھنٹوں میں مکمل ہوا۔

اسپارکو کے مطابق اس مشن کا بنیادی مقصد پاکستانی جامعات اور محققین کی جانب سے تیار کردہ سائنسی تجربات کو خلا میں انجام دینا ہے۔ ملک بھر کے تعلیمی اداروں سے موصول ہونے والی تین سو تحقیقی تجاویز میں سے چار منتخب تجربات کو میٹریل سائنس، فلوئیڈ فزکس، حیاتیاتی علوم اور بائیوٹیکنالوجی کے شعبوں میں پرکھا جا رہا ہے۔

وزیراعظم شہباز شریف اور صدر آصف علی زرداری سمیت اعلیٰ حکومتی شخصیات نے اس شاندار کامیابی پر قوم، اسپارکو اور خلاباز کو مبارکباد پیش کی ہے۔ اس تاریخی قدم سے پاکستان اور چین کے مابین سائنسی اور خلائی تحقیق کے شعبے میں تعاون کا ایک نیا باب شروع ہو گیا ہے۔

stories.title: Former Australia batter Usman Khawaja proposes compromise over Sandpapergate
stories.summary:
Former Australian cricket player Usman Khawaja revealed that he proposed a compromise to Cricket Australia regarding the 2018 ball-tampering scandal in South Africa, commonly known as Sandpapergate. The controversy resurfaced after Khawaja stated in his autobiography that the entire team had knowledge of the ball tampering, contrary to claims by the bowlers involved. The original scandal resulted in one-year bans for then-captain Steven Smith and vice-captain David Warner, and a nine-month ban for Cameron Bancroft.

Speaking on a podcast, Khawaja shared the text of a proposed statement he sent to Cricket Australia chief executive Todd Greenberg last week. The draft statement acknowledged that the team knowingly altered the condition of the ball in 2018, took full responsibility as a squad, and expressed gratitude and regret that Smith, Bancroft, and Warner paid an enormous price for the team. Cricket Australia did not immediately respond for comment, though the board previously announced an independent forum for players to share their accounts without fear of sanction and backed current captain Pat Cummins.

Khawaja also addressed his relationship with Pat Cummins, stating he was hurt by a press conference where Cummins felt Khawaja had been casual with players' reputations. Khawaja mentioned that he had texted Cummins days prior in hopes of finding a middle ground to bridge the divide within the team rather than building walls, emphasizing that he still cares deeply for the current captain despite the public disagreement.

The unfolding situation matters as it highlights ongoing internal divisions within Australian cricket regarding accountability for the historical scandal. The controversy continues to test leadership stability within the national team, particularly involving current captain Pat Cummins, as the organization attempts to address past actions while maintaining team cohesion ahead of the fifth and final Ashes Test match in Sydney.

stories.title: European Commission urges United States to honor agreed 15% tariff ceiling
stories.summary:
The European Commission stated that it expects any measures implemented by the United States to strictly respect the 15% tariff ceiling agreed upon for European Union goods imports. A Commission spokesperson made the remarks following the Trump administration's introduction of proposed new Section 301 tariffs. The spokesperson emphasized that the all-inclusive ceiling established in the previous joint statement applies to EU goods and must be respected in full, including when combined with existing duties.

In addition to addressing the tariff limits, the European Commission expressed regret over the absence of joint international action regarding global overcapacity. The spokesperson strongly rejected the underlying premise that Europe serves as a source of structural overcapacity. These developments highlight ongoing trade policy tensions between Washington and Brussels following previous bilateral negotiations and agreements.

The position taken by the European Commission matters because it sets the diplomatic and economic boundaries for trade relations between the two major economic powers. Ensuring adherence to the previously negotiated tariff cap is crucial for protecting European exporters from excessive duties and maintaining stability in transatlantic commerce amidst shifting US trade investigations.

stories.title: Trump plans meeting with Democratic Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed on universal healthcare
stories.summary:
United States President Donald Trump announced that he intends to meet with Democratic Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed of Michigan to discuss universal healthcare reform. The planned meeting signals a potential opening for bipartisan cooperation following a contentious election cycle. El-Sayed campaigned heavily on universal healthcare and sought to engage Trump directly by proposing to rebrand Medicare for All under the name “Trumpcare,” sharing an image of a gold card on social media to urge guaranteed healthcare coverage.

During an Oval Office interview, Trump praised El-Sayed as a smart individual who did a very good job promoting the healthcare branding concept, suggesting there might be room for a middle ground and compromise. While Trump anticipated initial tensions with incoming Democratic majorities in Congress, stating his intention to veto legislation initially before negotiations begin, he expressed optimism about accomplishing major policy goals together. The interaction marks a notable shift from the combative campaign period, during which Trump repeatedly attacked El-Sayed and Republican opponents ran aggressive campaigns against the Michigan Democrat, who is set to become the first Muslim US senator.

This potential dialogue matters because it bridges a wide political divide on a central domestic issue in American politics. Healthcare reform has long been a battleground between Democrats and Republicans, and any sign of compromise between Trump and a prominent progressive leader like El-Sayed could influence the legislative agenda of the incoming Congress and reshape the national debate on healthcare access.

stories.title: سوات میں چلتی موٹر سائیکل پر ایک ہاتھ سے وائرل کیچ پکڑنے والے مہران
stories.summary:
خیبر پختونخوا کے علاقے سوات میں سوات پریمیئر لیگ کے دوران چلتی موٹر سائیکل پر بیٹھے ہوئے ایک نوجوان مہران نے ایک ہاتھ سے شاندار کیچ پکڑ کر دنیا بھر کے کرکٹ شائقین کو دنگ کر دیا۔ یہ میچ سوات سٹرائیکرز اور جی کے آر دیر کے درمیان کھیلا جا رہا تھا۔

مرغزار کے رہائشی مہران پبلک ہیلتھ انجینئرنگ کے محلے میں ملازم ہیں اور دفتر سے گھر واپسی کے دوران کرکٹ کے شوق کے باعث میچ دیکھ رہے تھے۔ جب بلے باز ابرار لالہ کی جانب سے لگایا گیا چھکا گراؤنڈ سے باہر آیا تو انہوں نے اپنے موٹر سائیکل سوار ساتھی کو سر نیچے کرنے کا کہا اور ایک ہاتھ سے گیند تھام لی۔

اس غیر معمولی واقعے کی ویڈیو سوشل میڈیا پر تیزی سے وائرل ہو گئی جس کے بعد پاکستان سمیت آسٹریلیا، برطانیہ اور دیگر ممالک کے کرکٹ تجزیہ کاروں اور میڈیا نے اس کی بھرپور تعریف کی۔ سوات پریمیئر لیگ کی انتظامیہ اور پاکستان فوج کی جانب سے مہران کے لیے دس ہزار روپے انعام کا اعلان کیا گیا۔

بین الاقوامی میڈیا اداروں جیسے کہ آسٹریلیا کے سیون نیوز، گلف نیوز اور دی سن نے بھی اس انوکھے کیچ کو نمایاں کیا۔ مہران نے واضح کیا کہ انہوں نے کیچ پکڑنے کے بعد گیند فوراً واپس گراؤنڈ انتظامیہ کو لوٹا دی تھی اور وہ اس پذیرائی پر اللہ کے شکر گزار ہیں۔

stories.title: Wall Street tumbles as tech selloff and new tariffs rattle markets
stories.summary:
Major United States stock indexes plummeted, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq suffering a 4% loss, driven by persistent selling in artificial intelligence-linked stocks and newly proposed US tariffs. Wall Street experienced heavy volatility amid growing doubts over whether debt-financed investments in AI infrastructure can yield adequate financial returns. Concerns were further compounded by fears of heightened regulatory oversight following a Democratic sweep in the midterm elections, alongside ongoing reductions in the pace of capital expenditure for data center construction.

Chipmakers experienced the sharpest declines, with Nvidia shares falling 8.6% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunging 5.8%. Other major technology companies also dropped significantly, including Alphabet down 5%, Amazon shedding 4.9%, Microsoft falling 3.2%, and Apple dropping 1.4%. Additionally, the Nasdaq 100 briefly neared bear market territory by falling 20% from its record closing high. Concurrently, the introduction of proposed tariffs on 14 major trading partners—featuring a 20% excess-capacity levy on China in addition to prior duties—revived global trade tensions and complicated the economic outlook for investors already navigating expectations of prolonged high interest rates driven by inflation and rising oil prices.

Economic data released during the session showed the Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index rising 0.3% monthly and 3.8% annually in October, while third-quarter economic growth registered at a preliminary 4.3%. These figures reinforced expectations that the Federal Reserve may hike interest rates by at least 25 basis points before the end of 2026. Losses were widespread across the S&P 500, with technology leading sector declines down 5.2%, though some individual firms like HP gained following positive quarterly earnings reports.

This market downturn matters significantly as it puts major indexes, including the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq, on track for their worst November performance since 2008. The confluence of a cooling AI sector, renewed protectionist trade policies, and persistent inflation pressures creates a challenging environment for investors as markets head into the Thanksgiving holiday closure and a shortened trading session.

stories.title: AI Stocks Plunge Amid Rising Infrastructure Costs and Economic Pressures
stories.summary:
Artificial intelligence-linked stocks suffered a significant decline during premarket trading on Wednesday as investors evaluated the heavy, often debt-financed expenses of building AI infrastructure against uncertain financial returns. Market participants have adopted stringent expectations for AI companies, heavily penalizing any shortfalls while offering minimal reward for exceeding forecasts. Wall Street analysts expressed skepticism over whether the massive capital outlays by these firms will prove financially viable.

Several prominent server makers and semiconductor companies experienced steep losses. Dell Technologies shares dropped 6.1% despite raising its annual revenue and profit projections for the third time this year and authorizing a $25 billion share buyback. Rival server manufacturer HPE tumbled 16.3% following a previous forecast increase, while Super Micro and Ambarella saw shares fall 5.1% and 30.8%, respectively. Anthropic dropped 4.6%, trading well below its initial public offering price shortly after its Nasdaq debut. Broad market sentiment was further dampened by proposed tariffs from the Trump administration on 14 trading partners and rising US inflation figures for October.

Chipmakers and neocloud providers also faced intense market pressure due to debt concerns related to rapid expansion. Nvidia fell 5.9%, extending a previous 6% loss, while Nvidia-backed neocloud firms like CoreWeave and Nebius Group dropped about 8% each. Yields on CoreWeave bonds due in 2031 spiked toward 18% as prices declined to near record lows, and credit default swap spreads for major technology corporations such as Oracle, Alphabet, and SpaceX reached record levels.

Major AI hyperscalers experienced widespread declines, with Oracle, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta Platforms, and Microsoft falling between 3.1% and 6.1%. This downturn reflects mounting investor anxieties over potential data center slowdowns and stricter regulatory oversight, particularly following recent midterm election results.

stories.title: India foreign ministry says 'cockroach' movement leader Saurav Das advised not to use passport
stories.summary:
India's foreign ministry announced on Wednesday that passport authorities directed Saurav Das, a leader of the 'cockroach' movement, to refrain from using his passport until he provides clarification regarding his birthplace. Foreign ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal explained that authorities issue such notices when a discrepancy is identified or reported, which can amount to a suppression of facts. Das was consequently advised to withhold using the document until he submits a formal response.

The restriction came to light after Das stated on Monday that he was intercepted at the Delhi airport just hours before boarding a flight to London, where he intended to address students. Das alleged that the administration of Prime Minister Narendra Modi is attempting to suppress dissent and stifle debate by preventing his travel to Britain. In response to the government's actions, Das has filed a petition with the Delhi High Court, with the legal news website LiveLaw reporting that the plea is scheduled to be heard on Thursday.

Das previously gained attention on October 13 when he was among 14 individuals who scaled barricades to access the Jantar Mantar observatory in central Delhi, just a day after it was removed from the list of official protest sites. He was detained for several days following that incident. Furthermore, he led thousands of young supporters demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over voter list revisions that critics argue favor Modi’s Bharatiya Janata Party.

This political unrest follows a weeks-long sit-in staged earlier in the year by supporters of the 'cockroach' movement, an agitation that successfully forced Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan to resign in the wake of exam paper leaks. The ongoing conflict between Das's movement and the government highlights broader political tensions in the country surrounding freedom of expression, electoral processes, and public protests.

stories.title: NCCIA busts fraudulent Karachi call centre targeting elderly Americans, recovering millions
stories.summary:
The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) announced on Wednesday that it successfully dismantled a fraudulent call centre operating in Karachi, resulting in the arrest of five suspects and the recovery of Rs150 million in cash along with approximately Rs60m in cryptocurrency. According to an agency press release, the illicit operation targeted elderly United States citizens by making unsolicited calls and misrepresenting information regarding durable medical equipment and health insurance benefits.

Operating between 2020 and 2025 out of offices at Anam Empire on Sharea Faisal under the names 'Global Resource Group', 'Phoenix Marketing Solution', and 'The Call Solution', the network allegedly funneled roughly Rs1.2bn into Pakistan as proceeds of crime. An official first information report (FIR) was filed against 10 suspects, with five currently in custody and the remaining five, including a bank branch manager, absconding. Investigators invoked multiple sections of the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (Peca) and the Pakistan Penal Code, while also expanding the probe to include money laundering under the Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010.

According to the investigation, the syndicate obtained victims' personal and medical data and transferred it to a US-based medical billing partner that submitted unlawful claims to major health insurers such as Medicare, Humana, and UnitedHealthcare. After the billing partner deducted its commissions and expenses, the remaining funds were channeled back to Pakistan through illegal hawala and hundi networks, as well as merchant facilities, utilizing 23 fictitious bank accounts. These funds were subsequently converted into movable and immovable properties, luxury vehicles, and digital assets to conceal their illegal origins.

Authorities recovered Rs150m in cash, a currency-counting machine, four luxury vehicles valued at Rs48m, and digital assets including Rs60m in Binance cryptocurrency. They also seized electronic evidence such as 11 mobile phones, tablets, and laptops, alongside a passport and bank records linked to the fake firms. This operation follows a series of similar recent raids conducted by the NCCIA on Sharea Faisal and in PECHS, which previously led to the arrests of hundreds of individuals involved in international financial scams.

stories.title: واٹس ایپ کا تصویری اسٹیکرز کے ساتھ آویزاں آڈیو بھیجنے کا نیا فیچر
stories.summary:
مقبول ترین انسٹنٹ میسجنگ ایپلی کیشن واٹس ایپ اپنے صارفین کے لیے ایک دلچسپ اور نیا فیچر متعارف کرانے کی تیاری کر رہی ہے جس کے ذریعے اب تصویری اسٹیکرز کے ساتھ آواز بھی منسلک کی جا سکے گی۔ اس نئے فیچر کی آزمائش فی الحال اینڈرائیڈ ایپ کے پبلک بیٹا ورژن میں شروع کی گئی ہے۔

اس فیچر کے تحت صارفین اپنی موبائل گیلری کی کسی بھی ویڈیو کو اسٹیکر میں تبدیل کر سکیں گے اور اسٹیکر ایڈیٹر میں موجود آڈیو بٹن کے ذریعے اس میں آواز شامل کر سکیں گے۔ صارفین کو یہ اختیار حاصل ہوگا کہ وہ ویڈیو کی اصل آواز رکھیں، اپنی آواز ریکارڈ کریں یا پہلے سے محفوظ شدہ کوئی آڈیو فائل منتخب کریں۔

اس سہولت کی خاص بات یہ ہے کہ اسٹیکر حاصل کرنے والے شخص کو اس کے ساتھ ایک چھوٹا سا آڈیو آئیکون دکھائی دے گا اور آواز خود بخود نہیں چلے گی بلکہ صرف اسٹیکر پر ٹیپ کرنے پر ہی سنائی دے گی۔ یہ فیچر صرف صارف کے تیار کردہ اسٹیکرز تک محدود نہیں بلکہ عام اسٹیکرز کے ساتھ بھی استعمال ہو سکے گا۔

ٹیکنالوجی ویب سائٹ اینگیجٹ کے مطابق یہ فیچر اینڈرائیڈ کے بیٹا اپ ڈیٹ کا حصہ ہے اور خواہشمند صارفین گوگل پلے اسٹور کے ذریعے بیٹا ٹیسٹر بن سکتے ہیں۔ تاہم واٹس ایپ نے اس فیچر کو تمام عام صارفین کے لیے جاری کرنے کی حتمی تاریخ کا تاحال اعلان نہیں کیا ہے۔

stories.title: Six-Story Building Collapse in Karachi Kills Three and Injures 14
stories.summary:
At least three people died and 14 others sustained injuries when the upper floors of an under-construction six-story building collapsed near Baloch Colony in Karachi. Rescue officials stated that no residents were living in the structure at the time, and heavy machinery was deployed to clear debris and search for individuals reportedly trapped underneath. Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Centre officials confirmed that 14 injured victims were brought to the facility, with nine subsequently discharged after treatment.

Among those pulled from the rubble was a young worker named Ahmed, who reported working on the fifth floor alongside several colleagues when the incident occurred. Rescue operations identified other injured individuals as Nadir Hussain and Shaukat Ali. Karachi Mayor Murtaza Wahab visited the site to inspect relief efforts, declaring that illegal construction had led to multiple arrests and emphasizing that no negligence in rescue operations would be tolerated. The Sindh Building Control Authority reported that the project involved commercial construction on a residential plot measuring 600 square yards.

Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif expressed grief over the tragedy and urged swift medical assistance for the wounded. Sindh Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah also inspected the site and criticized the permitting process, noting that initial approvals were restricted to a ground-plus-one structure before six floors were unlawfully erected. He asserted that such extensive violations required the complicity of government officials and vowed strict punishment for the owner, consultant, contractor, and any responsible state personnel. Authorities noted that establishing the exact number of missing people remained difficult due to multiple contractors operating at the site.

stories.title: US Proposes 17% Tariff Cap on Indian Imports Contingent on Trade Deal
stories.summary:
United States Trade Representative Jamieson Greer announced that the US will cap tariffs on Indian imports at 17% if Washington and New Delhi successfully finalize a trade agreement. Without a formal trade deal, the levy on Indian goods is set to increase to 25%. The proposal forms part of broader US administrative actions targeting 14 trading partners to address structural excess industrial capacity.

The United States criticized several Indian economic policies, citing inadequate labor protections, financial repression, market access barriers, and industrial expansion strategies as unreasonable trade practices. Washington argued that these measures harm domestic producers, exports, and employment while elevating economic security risks through heavy reliance on non-market economy inputs, particularly in sectors such as steel, solar technology, pharmaceuticals, and medical devices.

Bilateral trade relations have fluctuated previously, with both nations agreeing to a framework in February that lowered punitive tariffs on most Indian goods to 18% following earlier friction. Although a subsequent Supreme Court ruling invalidated the emergency powers used to implement sweeping global tariffs—dropping the baseline rate to 10%—a comprehensive and final trade pact between the two economies remains pending. Indian officials confirmed that bilateral discussions between New Delhi and Washington are ongoing.

stories.title: Yemeni Houthis Claim Drone Attack on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura Refinery
stories.summary:
Yemen’s Houthi movement stated that it launched an attack on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura oil refinery, the kingdom's largest facility, situated near a major crude export terminal in the Eastern Province. Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree reported that the strike triggered fires at the site. The Saudi-led coalition confirmed that air defenses intercepted and destroyed four drones over Ras Tanura but did not acknowledge any direct hit to the refinery itself. Satellite imagery from NASA reviewed by Reuters revealed extensive thick black smoke covering a 600-square-kilometer area around the complex.

The Ras Tanura facility, which possesses a refining capacity of 550,000 barrels per day, has experienced previous attacks during the ongoing regional conflicts. The escalation follows a reignition of Yemen's civil war in July as a spillover from the wider US-Iran conflict, which has previously disrupted Aramco operations and forced the postponement of major international events in Saudi Arabia. Neither the Saudi government communications office nor state oil giant Aramco provided immediate comments regarding the refinery incident.

Additionally, the Houthis claimed responsibility for a multi-phase assault on Riyadh's financial district. Saudi civil defense reported that 11 people were wounded when a strike hit the tallest building in the capital, which houses the headquarters of the Public Investment Fund. This marked the second attack on the landmark sovereign wealth fund tower in less than a week, following a previous strike on November 19 that caused structural damage without injuries.

stories.title: غزہ میں جنگ کے باعث قبرستانوں میں جگہ کی شدید قلت
stories.summary:
غزہ میں جاری جنگ کے دوران اموات کی تعداد میں بے پناہ اضافے کے باعث گورکنوں کو شدید مشکلات کا سامنا ہے۔ 1986 سے گورکن کے طور پر کام کرنے والے 61 سالہ یوسف احمد سلیم ابو حطب کا کہنا ہے کہ انھوں نے حالیہ تین برسوں میں 18 ہزار سے زائد لاشیں دفن کی ہیں، جو ان کے پورے کیریئر سے زیادہ ہیں۔ غزہ کی وزارتِ صحت کے مطابق جنگ میں اب تک 74,645 افراد ہلاک ہو چکے ہیں۔

قبرستانوں میں جگہ ختم ہونے کی وجہ سے گورکنوں کو کئی دہائی پرانی قبریں دوبارہ کھولنا پڑی ہیں تاکہ ایک ہی خاندان کے نئے شہداء کو پہلے سے دفن افراد کے اوپر یا ساتھ دفنایا جا سکے۔ جگہ کی اس شدید کمی کے باعث جو قبرستان صرف 20 لاشوں کے لیے بنایا گیا تھا، وہاں 60 لاشیں دفن کی گئی ہیں اور ایک نئی قبر کی قیمت بڑھ کر 300 ڈالر تک پہنچ گئی ہے۔

تدفین کے لیے درکار بنیادی اشیاء جیسے کہ کفن، غسل کے لیے صابن، اور قبروں کے لیے پتھر یا سلیب بھی نایاب ہو چکے ہیں۔ پتھر نایاب ہونے کی وجہ سے تباہ شدہ گھروں کا ملبہ استعمال کیا جا رہا ہے جہاں سے لوگ پتھر نکال کر دو ڈالر سے زائد قیمت پر فروخت کرتے ہیں۔ بعض اوقات پورے خاندانوں کو بغیر قبر کے ریت میں براہِ راست یا اجتماعی طور پر دفن کرنا پڑا ہے۔

معاشی تنگی اور علاج کی سہولت نہ ہونے کے باعث 16 سالہ سراج صیام جو کہ آنتوں کے کینسر میں مبتلا ہیں، خاندان کی کفالت کے لیے روزانہ قبریں کھودنے کا کام کرتے ہیں۔ بیمار والدین اور گھر میں واحد کمانے والے فرد ہونے کی وجہ سے وہ یومیہ چھ سے نو ڈالر اجرت پر یہ تھکا دینے والا کام کرنے پر مجبور ہیں۔

غزہ کے رہائشیوں اور گورکنوں کا کہنا ہے کہ موجودہ حالات میں مردوں کے لیے جگہ ناپید ہو چکی ہے یہاں تک کہ قبرستانوں کے اردگرد کی زمین بھی بے گھر افراد کے خیموں سے بھری ہوئی ہے۔ ابو احمد کا کہنا ہے کہ اگر اختیار ہو تو وہ نئی قبر کی جگہ زندہ انسانوں کو خیمہ لگانے کے لیے ترجیح دیں گے کیونکہ زندہ انسان زیادہ ضرورت مند ہیں۔

stories.title: Qatari LNG Shipments Reach Post-War High Despite Skyrocketing Insurance Costs
stories.summary:
Qatari liquefied natural gas shipments are heading toward their busiest month since the United States-Iran conflict began, despite a significant surge in insurance expenses. Data gathered by the analytics organization Kpler indicates that the Ras Laffan export facility recorded 36 vessel berthings during November, surpassing the 21 berthings seen in September and 35 in October. Out of the November total, 29 tankers turned off their Automatic Identification System signals, compared to seven in September and 27 in October.

As the world's leading supplier of liquefied natural gas, Qatar transports nearly its entire output through the Strait of Hormuz. Although November loading numbers represent the strongest performance since the war's outbreak at the end of February, overall shipments stay at roughly 40 percent of pre-conflict volumes according to industry analysts.

While early anxieties centered on potential blockages within the Strait of Hormuz, experts note that financial repercussions have become the more immediate challenge. War-risk insurance coverage for vessels entering the Gulf has climbed from about 0.25 percent of a ship's value early in the year up to five percent or higher, as stated by Wood Mackenzie research director Ikram Elloumi. For a contemporary tanker valued near $250 million, this extra expense adds between $2.5 million and $12.5 million per voyage, whereas older, less valuable vessels experience much smaller increases.

Market dynamics and negotiating leverage dictate who ultimately pays these extra fees. Elloumi explained that when supplies are constrained, competing buyers typically absorb the expenses to guarantee their cargoes, whereas balanced markets may cause producers to experience diminished returns. Consequently, war-risk charges have transitioned from basic operational expenses into a vital element of trade economics.

stories.title: Pakistan Celebrates First Astronaut in Space Aboard Chinese Tiangong Mission
stories.summary:
Excitement filled an Islamabad auditorium before dawn on Wednesday as a Pakistani pilot lifted off on an unprecedented space journey in northwest China. Muhammad Zesahen Ali, a payload specialist and Pakistan Air Force pilot, became the first foreign national to join a Chinese space flight and the first non-Chinese individual to enter the Tiangong space station.

Crowds of officials, students, and scientists gathered at the headquarters of the national space commission in the capital to watch Ali depart aboard the Shenzhou-24 alongside two Chinese crew members, while the national anthem played. Physics and astronomy student Zainab Abbasi expressed awe at witnessing the historic event, noting it was hard to imagine seeing a compatriot reach space so soon. Ali marks the first person from Pakistan to achieve orbit, following adventurer Namira Salim's commercial suborbital flight in October 2023. Ali is scheduled to spend a week in orbit before returning on the Shenzhou-23 spaceship already docked at the station.

Muhammad Yousaf Khan, head of the Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission, expressed surprise at the large turnout for the early morning launch. Khan noted that Ali will conduct four orbital experiments, which include studying microalgae, growing quinoa beyond Earth, and testing self-healing materials for spacecraft. These projects were chosen from over 300 university proposals. The rigorous selection process screened over 50 candidates before sending 19 to China for testing, ultimately choosing Ali and naval officer Khurram Daud after roughly seven months of training.

Pakistan's space journey began in 1961 with its first rocket launch the following year, and the nation now partners closely with China to pursue its space ambitions following a bilateral agreement signed in February 2025. Professor Raza Akbar of the Institute of Space Technology described gaining independence from Beijing as a gradual mentoring process. Reflecting on the partnership, Akbar compared their cooperation to the height of the Himalayas, noting that while the mountain range reaches nine kilometers, today's achievement extends 400 kilometers into space.

stories.title: United States Inflation Accelerates Further in October, Keeping Rate Hikes Likely
stories.summary:
Consumer inflation in the United States advanced further during October, strengthening predictions that the Federal Reserve could prolong interest rate increases into early 2027. Data released Wednesday by the Commerce Department's Bureau of Economic Analysis showed that the Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index grew 0.3% last month, following an unrevised 0.5% increase in September. This matched predictions made by economists polled by Reuters. Over the 12-month period ending in October, the index climbed 3.8%, compared to a 3.6% advance the previous month.

When omitting volatile energy and food sectors, the core PCE Price Index also rose 0.3% over the month, matching September's unrevised figure. On a 12-month basis, core inflation reached 3.3% in October following a 3.1% rise in September. The United States central bank closely monitors these PCE metrics to gauge its 2% inflation goal. According to CME's FedWatch tool, financial markets anticipate a quarter-percentage-point rate increase during the December 8-9 meeting, which would build on the current 3.75% to 4.00% range, with another hike expected in January. Furthermore, Fed Governor Christopher Waller has indicated openness to a larger half-percentage-point adjustment to combat inflation.

Strong consumer demand and heavy corporate investment in artificial intelligence continue to drive price pressures upward. Consumer spending, which constitutes over two-thirds of domestic economic activity, expanded 0.3% in October after an upwardly revised 0.6% gain in September. Wealth generated by the stock market prior to recent artificial intelligence sell-offs has primarily supported higher-income households in their spending habits.

Meanwhile, historically low layoff rates and steady hiring assist other households in maintaining expenditures, even though rising prices continue to diminish wage growth. Consumers are also reducing their savings and depleting financial reserves. Economists project that persistent inflation will eventually cause consumer spending to decelerate moving into 2027.

stories.title: United States proposes tariffs of up to 20pc on fourteen economies, including China and India
stories.summary:
The United States unveiled proposed tariffs of up to 20 per cent on Wednesday targeting 14 economies, including major trade partners such as the European Union, China, and India. A senior US official, speaking anonymously, explained that the duties stem from a months-long investigation initiated by the US Trade Representative in March regarding alleged excess manufacturing capacity and production. The administration argues that these economies are promoting production divorced from market principles and real demand, potentially depressing global prices and harming US manufacturing.

The proposed levies apply to a diverse group of trading partners, including Bangladesh, Cambodia, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, Singapore, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, and Vietnam, alongside China and the EU. Specifically, a 20 per cent tariff has been proposed for China, representing the joint-highest rate among the affected economies. Additionally, the Office of the US Trade Representative announced separate proposed tariffs on Brazilian goods, such as aircraft, citing a lack of action on US trade concerns. The new measures will undergo a public comment period and are expected to take effect in January at the earliest.

This latest trade action is part of US President Donald Trump’s broader effort during his second term to reshape global trade relationships and compel nations to purchase American goods or manufacture domestically. The administration maintains that the proposals account for existing trade agreements and will not generate friction as Trump prepares to host G20 leaders in Miami in December. However, economists warn that the duties could increase financial pressure on domestic businesses and consumers who are already dealing with high inflation and the economic fallout from previous tariffs and policies.

The announcement arrives shortly after the US Supreme Court struck down a previous set of global tariffs in February because the executive branch lacked the authority to implement them under the cited law. Despite this legal setback, the administration's sector-specific duties remain in place. Officials clarified that the new excess-capacity tariffs will not stack on top of existing sector-specific levies or earlier tariffs imposed in July over forced labor concerns; instead, the higher rate of any overlapping tariffs will prevail.

stories.title: California grand jury indicts Meghan Markle's estranged father on child pornography charges
stories.summary:
Thomas Markle, the 82-year-old estranged father of Britain's Duchess of Sussex, Meghan Markle, was indicted on Tuesday by a California grand jury on two counts of possession of child pornography. Currently held in custody in Florida after cutting off an electronic ankle monitor required for his house arrest, Markle is anticipated to face arraignment in the United States District Court in Los Angeles in the coming weeks. The indictment asserts that Markle possessed 35mm film negatives depicting child sexual abuse, including at least one image involving a prepubescent minor.

Federal prosecutors stated that FBI agents recovered dozens of illicit images stored on slides, film negatives, and books from two rented storage facilities in Los Angeles as well as from his previous residence in the Philippines. Court filings indicate that certain images appear to feature Markle alongside children who are either naked or partially dressed. Meanwhile, a Florida judge ordered a psychiatric examination for Markle this month after determining there is reasonable cause to believe he may be mentally incompetent and unable to understand the legal proceedings or assist in his defense.

Legal authorities in the Philippines also initiated criminal complaints against Markle last week in Cebu, where he reportedly resided for over a year. Regional prosecutor Graeme Elmido noted that local police recommended filing two counts of distributing child sexual abuse material and one count of possessing it under Philippine law. These complaints will undergo preliminary evaluation before any formal investigation subpoenas are issued to Markle.

Public attention surrounding the case intensified in October when British tabloid The Sun reported that Markle's son, Thomas Markle Jr., discovered child abuse images while sorting through belongings at his father's former home in the Philippines. Following these revelations, Meghan Markle expressed deep distress over the accusations and stated that she had previously blocked contact between her father and her children due to troubling behavior. Meghan married Britain's Prince Harry in 2018, and the couple subsequently stepped back from royal duties in 2020.

stories.title: Senate Panel Questions Regulators Over Fraud Allegedly Using Hum Network Name
stories.summary:
The Senate Standing Committee on Finance convened on Wednesday under the leadership of Senator Saleem Mandviwalla to address growing concerns regarding alleged financial fraud and the transfer of billions of rupees abroad. The session focused on digital platforms and payment schemes allegedly misusing the name of the established media enterprise, Hum Network. Lawmakers questioned regulatory authorities about how illicit financial activities, awards schemes, and gambling websites could operate under a registered corporate identity without immediate detection or intervention by financial watchdogs.

During the proceedings, officials from the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan informed the committee that Hum Network Limited is a publicly listed broadcasting firm established in 2004, led by chairperson Sultana Siddiqui and chief executive officer Duraid. Representatives from the commission stated they had no prior knowledge of any illegal enterprises operating under that title and confirmed they had previously sent an inquiry letter requesting details concerning a Dubai-based entity and related bank accounts linked to Hum News Network.

Senator Mandviwalla clarified during the discussion that the scrutiny did not target the legitimate television channel or Hum Network Limited, but rather a separate payment network unconnected to the broadcaster. He expressed astonishment at the regulatory body's lack of awareness regarding the alleged schemes, emphasizing that oversight obligations extend to auditing and penalizing violations across registered banking and digital channels. The Federal Board of Revenue chairman noted that the matter fell within the specific jurisdiction of financial regulators and central banking authorities.

To ensure a comprehensive examination, the committee decided to formally summon high-ranking officials from the State Bank of Pakistan, the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan, the National Crime Agency, and other relevant institutions to its upcoming session. A detailed briefing will be provided by these agencies to trace the unusual financial transfers conducted through conventional banks, digital platforms, and online services.

This parliamentary inquiry matters because it highlights potential vulnerabilities in national digital payment systems and oversight mechanisms that could enable large-scale illicit capital flight. By demanding accountability from key financial regulators and law enforcement bodies, the committee aims to safeguard public financial integrity and clarify the extent of illicit operations exploiting well-known corporate titles.

stories.title: Fatima Sana Returns to Captain Pakistan Women Squad for West Indies Tour
stories.summary:
All-rounder Fatima Sana has been reinstated as captain to lead a 15-member Pakistan women’s cricket squad for the upcoming tour of the West Indies next month. The Pakistan Cricket Board announced the squad on Wednesday, setting the stage for a busy series that includes three T20 Internationals and three One-Day Internationals. The 50-over matches carry significant weight as they form part of the ongoing ICC Women’s Championship 2025-29, where Pakistan currently holds fifth place in the standings after securing five victories across nine matches.

The entirety of the six-match bilateral series is scheduled to take place at Windsor Park in Roseau, running from December 8 to December 20. The T20 International fixtures will be contested on December 8, 10, and 12, while the One-Day International encounters will follow on December 15, 17, and 20. This tour provides an opportunity for the national side to improve its championship standing and secure crucial points in international women's cricket.

The 25-year-old captain had previously missed Pakistan's 14-member squad selection for the ICC Women’s Emerging Nations Trophy. Her absence during that period was due to her maiden overseas franchise commitments in Australia’s Women’s Big Bash League, where she debuted this season. Her return brings experienced leadership back to the national setup ahead of the Caribbean challenge.

The selected touring squad features a balanced mix of experience and emerging talent. Alongside captain Fatima Sana, the roster includes Ayesha Zafar, Gull Feroza, Momina Riasat, wicket-keepers Muneeba Ali and Najiha Alvi, Nashra Sundhu, Sadaf Shamas, Shawaal Zulfiqar, Sidra Amin, Syeda Aroob Shah, Tasmia Rubab, Tuba Hassan, Umm-e-Hani, and Waheeda Akhtar.

This upcoming series is important for Pakistan's aspirations in international cricket and regional rankings. Securing victories in the West Indies will boost team morale and strengthen their position in the multi-year ICC Women’s Championship table.

stories.title: Rawalpindiz Secure Matthew Short as Direct PSL Signing While Hyderabad Opt Out
stories.summary:
The Rawalpindiz franchise has secured Australian all-rounder Matthew Short as their marquee direct signing for the upcoming 12th edition of the Pakistan Super League. The agreement, announced on Wednesday, brings the Adelaide Strikers captain to the franchise for a reported fee of Rs9.15 crore ahead of the tournament, which is scheduled to take place from March 18 to May 2 next year. Short stands out as one of the highest-paid direct acquisitions for the upcoming season.

The 31-year-old cricketer is widely recognized for his aggressive top-order batting and useful right-arm off-spin, having earned the Big Bash League Player of the Tournament award twice. His extensive global franchise experience includes stints in the Indian Premier League, The Hundred, and Major League Cricket. Although previously selected by Islamabad United for PSL 10, Short was unable to participate due to a recurring injury sustained during the ICC Champions Trophy 2025, making this upcoming campaign his anticipated PSL debut with the Rawalpindi-based side.

Under Pakistan Cricket Board regulations, each franchise is granted the privilege of making one direct signing of a marquee player who did not participate in the 10th or 11th PSL editions. While Rawalpindi finalized their star player, the Hyderabad Kingsmen chose a different path, announcing via social media that they would bypass the direct-signing option to concentrate entirely on upcoming player auctions and retention strategies.

Other franchises have also completed their pre-auction roster additions. Islamabad United acquired Matt Henry, Karachi Kings secured Adil Rashid, Multan Sultans signed Lance Morris, Lahore Qalandars brought in Kamindu Mendis, and Quetta Gladiators added Lockie Ferguson. Meanwhile, defending champions Peshawar Zalmi have not yet made an official announcement regarding their direct signing, though reports have linked them with England player Ben Duckett.

These early roster moves are crucial for shaping team dynamics ahead of the official player draft scheduled for January 23. Securing established international stars helps franchises build competitive squads early and generates significant fan engagement ahead of the tournament's opening matches.

stories.title: پہلا پاکستانی خلا باز محمد ذیشان علی چینی خلائی سٹیشن پہنچ گئے
stories.summary:
پاکستان کے پہلے خلا باز محمد ذیشان علی چینی مشن شینژو 24 کے ہمراہ تیانگونگ خلائی سٹیشن پہنچ گئے ہیں۔ بدھ کے روز جیوچوان سیٹلائٹ لانچ سینٹر سے روانہ ہونے والا یہ مشن زمین سے سفر مکمل کرنے کے بعد چینی خلائی سٹیشن سے منسلک ہو گیا، جہاں پہلے سے موجود شینژو 23 کے عملے نے نئے مہمانوں کا خیرمقدم کیا۔

بطور پے لوڈ سپیشلسٹ جانے والے ذیشان علی اس مشن کے تحت تقریباً ایک ہفتہ خلائی سٹیشن پر گزاریں گے اور سائنسی تجربات میں حصہ لیں گے۔ وہ مائیکرو ایلجی کی افزائش اور کوئنوا کے بیجوں پر خلائی ماحول کے اثرات کا مطالعہ کریں گے۔ چینی خلائی پروگرام کے تحت ان کی خوراک اور زبان کی ضروریات کا خاص خیال رکھا گیا ہے اور حلال خلائی خوراک کا بندوبست کیا گیا ہے۔

خلائی سٹیشن پہنچنے پر ذیشان علی نے علامہ اقبال کا مشہور شعر 'ستاروں سے آگے جہاں اور بھی ہیں' پڑھ کر سنایا جسے ساتھیوں نے بہت سراہا۔ اس سٹیشن پر خلا باز ورزش، سائنسی تحقیق اور روزمرہ کے امور سر انجام دیتے ہیں جہاں پانی اور خوراک کو خصوصی سائنسی طریقوں سے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔

یہ سنگ میل پاکستان کے لیے خلائی تحقیق کی تاریخ میں ایک اہم قدم ہے۔ اس سے پاکستان اور چین کے درمیان سائنسی اور خلائی تعاون کو فروغ ملا ہے اور بین الاقوامی سطح پر پاکستانی نوجوانوں کی صلاحیتیں اجاگر ہوئی ہیں۔

stories.title: Government decreases petrol and diesel prices for November 26
stories.summary:
The federal government reduced the price of petrol by Rs4 per litre and high-speed diesel by Rs5 per litre for November 26, according to a press release issued by the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority. Following the revision, petrol was priced at Rs314 per litre, while high-speed diesel was set at Rs48 per litre.

The adjustment followed a previous reduction on November 25, when petrol prices dropped by Re1 and diesel fell by Rs4. Earlier on November 2, the government announced that oil refineries would absorb a monthly burden of Rs15 billion to keep petrol Rs15 cheaper than global rates amidst the US-Israeli conflict on Iran.

A daily pricing mechanism was instituted on July 17 to replace the previous weekly schedule due to ongoing volatility in global oil markets driven by US-Iran tensions. Furthermore, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif announced a relief scheme on September 13 to offer Rs100 per litre discounts on petrol for motorcycles, rickshaws, and cars under 800cc to assist lower-income consumers.

To conserve fuel, the government also introduced restrictive operating hours for businesses and commercial venues on September 17. Under these rules, shops and shopping malls are required to close by 9pm, wedding halls by 10pm, and restaurants by 11pm daily, with takeaway and delivery services exempted from the timing mandates.

stories.title: Imran and Bushra's counsel argues £190m transaction brought financial benefits
stories.summary:
During a hearing at the Islamabad High Court on November 25, 2026, Barrister Salman Safdar argued that the £190 million corruption case transaction caused no loss to the national exchequer and instead proved financially beneficial. A division bench comprising IHC Chief Justice Sardar Muhammad Sarfraz Dogar and Justice Muhammad Asif heard the appeals filed by former prime minister Imran Khan and his wife, Bushra Bibi, against their January 2025 accountability court convictions.

At the outset of the proceedings, the defense counsel requested live-streaming of the court sessions to ensure public transparency, noting that the trial had been conducted behind closed doors inside Adiala jail. Chief Justice Dogar observed that rules regarding live-streaming were yet to be finalized and that the application could not be approved at this stage, adding that the courtroom was already open to the public.

Arguing the main appeals, Barrister Safdar stated that the prosecution had produced 35 witnesses and that Imran was convicted under multiple provisions of the National Accountability Ordinance. He maintained that alleged financial benefits were extended by Bahria Town before accounts belonging to property tycoon Malik Riaz and his family were frozen by the UK's National Crime Agency. He also noted that several individuals, including Mirza Shahzad Akbar and Malik Riaz, were declared absconders in the case.

The defense counsel contended that the funds transferred to the Supreme Court account in connection with a land dispute had yielded significant profits over four years. He argued that there was no evidence establishing Imran's active knowledge of any wrongdoing, pointing out that neither Imran nor Bushra had signed the confidentiality agreement that facilitated the recovery of the frozen funds.

stories.title: Pakistani Pilot Becomes First Foreign Astronaut on China's Tiangong Station
stories.summary:
Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, a forty-year-old former Pakistan Air Force pilot, has achieved a historic milestone by becoming the first Pakistani in orbit and the first foreign astronaut to join a crewed mission on China's Tiangong space station. Arriving on November 25, 2026, aboard the Shenzhou-24 spacecraft, Ali joined Chinese astronauts Tang Hongbo and Wu Yi for a mission designed to advance bilateral scientific cooperation between Pakistan and China.

Selected in April 2026, Ali spent seven months undergoing rigorous preparation at the Astronaut Centre of China in Beijing. His training encompassed spacecraft systems, emergency responses, scientific procedures, and intensive Chinese-language instruction to facilitate communication with his crewmates. Serving as a payload specialist, Ali is tasked with conducting four joint research projects selected from over three hundred proposals submitted to Pakistan’s Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission.

The scientific projects focus on materials science and biotechnology, including lightweight graphene-based radiation shields, self-healing carbon-fibre composites, and the cultivation of quinoa seeds, microalgae, and cyanobacteria in microgravity. These experiments aim to improve spacecraft durability and support sustainable food and oxygen production for extended space missions. China arranged specially prepared halal meals and bilingual operating manuals to support his stay.

Ali's mission is scheduled to last between five and ten days in orbit. In a unique logistical arrangement, he is not expected to return on the spacecraft that brought him; instead, he will travel back to Earth aboard the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft alongside Chinese astronauts Zhang Zhiyuan and Li Jiaying. This milestone highlights decades of space collaboration between Pakistan and China, laying the groundwork for potential future joint endeavors beyond Earth.

stories.title: Pakistan Urges UN Security Council to Implement AI Military Guardrails
stories.summary:
Pakistan has called upon the United Nations Security Council to institute strict international regulatory frameworks and guardrails to prevent emerging technologies and artificial intelligence from triggering a destabilizing arms race. Ambassador Syed Haider Shah, Pakistan's permanent representative to the UN, addressed a high-level 15-member Council debate on emerging technologies and conflict resolution under the Latvian presidency, emphasizing that nuclear launch decisions must strictly remain under human control.

During the session, the Pakistani envoy stressed the critical need for military restraint and confidence-building measures to mitigate the dangers of miscalculation and compressed decision-making timelines caused by integrating AI into military operations. He specifically demanded an absolute prohibition against employing AI capabilities to target nuclear command, control, and communications systems, warning that algorithms should never be used to compress human judgment during crises.

United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres echoed these concerns at the outset of the meeting, noting that modern wars have become testing grounds for AI-enabled targeting and intelligence gathering. Guterres stressed that as long as nuclear weapons exist, the decision to use them must rest exclusively with human beings, adding that killer robots must have no place in the future. He also reiterated his urgent call to launch negotiations for a legally binding instrument addressing lethal autonomous weapon systems.

Furthermore, the UN chief highlighted that the rapid, uncontrolled race for AI is being driven by commercial interests and geopolitical rivalry, while the massive energy and water consumption of AI data centers inflames community tensions. He stated that the Security Council holds a special duty to ensure technological competition does not destabilize international peace, asserting that countries wielding the greatest AI capabilities carry the heaviest responsibilities.

stories.title: Oil Tankers Explode After Striking Naval Mines in the Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary:
Two oil tankers suffered explosions and caught fire after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, according to a statement from Iran’s Revolutionary Guards Navy carried by state media. Iranian military officials asserted that the vessels were navigating through an unauthorized route within the vital waterway. The incident underscores heightened risks in the region as Tehran tightens control over maritime traffic.

In a related development, Iranian Army spokesperson Mohammad Akraminia announced that the military has deployed new surveillance systems and upgraded existing equipment to monitor the strait. Akraminia warned that ships attempting passage without coordinating directly with Iranian forces face severe hazards, noting that vessels failing to cooperate have struck mines during recent weeks.

Tehran has communicated to Washington that normal shipping operations will not resume in the Strait of Hormuz until specific conditions are met. Iran's demands include the termination of the U.S. naval blockade targeting Iranian ports and an end to the ongoing war on all fronts. Transmitted through Qatari mediators, Tehran's proposal indicates readiness to reopen the vital maritime trade route within forty-eight hours should Washington fulfill these stipulated terms.

stories.title: Indian Equities Surge Toward Annual Recovery Amid Massive Foreign Inflows
stories.summary:
Indian stock markets rallied on Wednesday, nearly wiping out their year-to-date losses and positioning the benchmarks for their strongest monthly performance since April 2020. The market surge has been driven by lower oil prices, strong corporate earnings, and a massive influx of foreign capital. Investors poured a record $14.28 billion into Indian equities this month as funds rotated away from global artificial intelligence-linked shares.

The broader market gains lifted the Nifty 50 by 1.85 percent to close at 25,819.25, while the Sensex rose 1.82 percent to settle at 83,938.28 following a local holiday on Tuesday. Meanwhile, the Indian rupee recovered from historic lows, appreciating by up to 2.9 percent over the course of the month. These gains contrasted sharply with the broader MSCI Asia-Pacific index outside Japan, which fell 3.3 percent amid renewed concerns over prospective United States tariffs and a fading technology rally.

India emerged as Asia's top-performing market for the month, with the Nifty 50 gaining more than 15 percent in dollar terms. Analysts noted that strong earnings momentum, low foreign positioning, and insulation from AI market concentration make India an attractive hedge. Economists forecast a 7.6 percent growth rate for the Indian economy during the July-September quarter, matching corporate earnings that reached a four-year high for the same period.

Sector-wide advances bolstered the market, with heavyweight financials and information technology posting notable increases. HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank climbed 3.5 percent and 3.4 percent respectively, while Reliance Industries added 1.7 percent. Concurrently, Brent crude futures declined slightly to $91 per barrel due to rising supply expectations, contributing to a monthly price drop of approximately 22.5 percent.

stories.title: MQM-P Files for Permission to Hold Karachi Rally for Urban Province
stories.summary:
The Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan formally applied for administrative permission on Wednesday to hold a public rally and gathering at Jinnah Ground in Karachi. Taha Ahmed Khan, the party's deputy parliamentary leader, submitted the official request for a No-Objection Certificate to Karachi Commissioner Hassan Naqvi for the proposed event scheduled for November 29.

In the formal application, MQM-P asked the city administration to provide necessary security and administrative support to ensure the peaceful execution of the gathering. The primary objective of the November 29 rally is to mobilize public backing for the creation of a new province representing urban Sindh.

Meanwhile, the ruling Pakistan Peoples Party has initiated discussions with various nationalist factions and the MQM-P. The PPP has urged these political entities to postpone their planned rallies and public demonstrations on November 29 to mitigate the risk of potential political clashes within the region.

stories.title: India Ministry Says Cockroach Movement Leader Das Told Not To Use Passport
stories.summary:
India's foreign ministry announced on Wednesday that passport authorities instructed Saurav Das, a leader of the 'cockroach' movement and chief spokesperson of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), to refrain from using his passport until he clarifies information regarding his place of birth. Das stated on Monday that he was intercepted at Delhi airport prior to a scheduled flight to London to address students, following a notice issued by passport authorities. He claimed that Prime Minister Narendra Modi's administration is attempting to suppress dissent and stifle debate by blocking his international travel.

Foreign ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal explained that authorities issue such notices when a discrepancy is identified or reported, which constitutes a suppression of facts. Jaiswal confirmed that Das was advised against using his passport pending a submitted response. In response to the government's actions, Das has petitioned the Delhi High Court, with a hearing scheduled for Thursday, according to legal news website LiveLaw. Das recently led thousands of young supporters demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over voter list revisions that critics argue favor Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).

Additionally, Das alleged on social media platform X that social media accounts aligned with the BJP leaked his passport details online, accusing the ruling party of doxxing and a sustained campaign of harassment. He claimed that his Delhi residential address had previously been leaked, YouTubers had entered his home while he was away, and fabricated reports and morphed photographs of him were distributed online. Das stated his intention to file a criminal complaint against every social media handle involved in circulating his passport and vowed that individuals will eventually face the law.

The controversy follows an incident on October 13 where Das and 13 others scaled barricades to enter the Jantar Mantar observatory in central Delhi a day after it was removed from designated protest sites, resulting in a brief detention. The 'cockroach' movement previously organized a weeks-long sit-in earlier in the year that prompted the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan over exam paper leaks. The ongoing dispute highlights escalating tensions between opposition figures and the central government over civil liberties and political dissent in India.

stories.title: AB de Villiers Urges Cricket to Move On From Sandpapergate Scandal
stories.summary:
Former South Africa cricket captain AB de Villiers stated that the sport must learn lessons from the 2018 ball-tampering scandal involving Australia, while urging the cricket community to move past "Sandpapergate." The controversy resurfaced this year following claims in a book by Australia batter Usman Khawaja suggesting that awareness of the plan to use sandpaper on the ball during the test series in South Africa went beyond the three disciplined players: Cameron Bancroft, David Warner, and Steve Smith. De Villiers emphasized that while a mistake occurred that affected the global game, past incidents of a similar nature were eventually moved past.

Speaking during a virtual roundtable organized by Test Twenty20, a new format utilizing both red and white balls across genders, De Villiers stressed the importance of youngsters taking responsibility to inject great energy and integrity into the sport. During the 2018 tour, Australia won the opening test in Durban before South Africa secured a 3-1 series victory by winning the final three matches. De Villiers scored an unbeaten century in the second test in Port Elizabeth and was present on the field when Bancroft was filmed using sandpaper on the ball during the third test in Cape Town.

Addressing the regulations surrounding the game, De Villiers noted that administrators must clearly define boundaries so players do not step over them. He emphasized that reverse swing is a valuable and necessary part of cricket that benefits bowlers and quickens the pace of the match. He called on cricket administrators to clear up any grey areas surrounding the practice to ensure reverse swing survives for years to come.

The renewed debate has also drawn remarks from other former players, including former Australia bowler Chadd Sayers, who claimed that everyone knew about the plot. Meanwhile, Khawaja declined to confirm whether Australia's bowlers were aware of the ball-tampering scheme. The ongoing discussions continue to spark debate within international cricket circles regarding accountability and regulatory clarity regarding on-field conduct.

stories.title: National Conference in Islamabad Demands Stronger Safeguards for Journalist Safety and Freedom of Expression
stories.summary:
A national conference held in Islamabad on Wednesday called for enhanced protections for freedom of expression, journalist safety, and institutional accountability, alongside greater respect for the public's right to information and specific measures to protect women journalists from online and offline harassment. The gathering took place against the backdrop of growing concerns over censorship following the enactment of the Prevention of Electronic Crimes (Amendment) Act, 2025, which was passed by the Senate on January 28, 2025, and expanded government powers to regulate digital content and penalize offenses. Rights activists, journalists, and media organizations have widely criticized the legislation for undermining free speech.

Freedom Network Executive Director Iqbal Khattak emphasized that a society should be measured by how well it protects speech with which those in power disagree. Participants generated several recommendations, including institutionalizing journalist safety training in newsrooms, diversifying revenue streams through subscription models to reduce reliance on government advertising, and implementing human oversight and editorial verification to counter AI-driven misinformation. Discussions on gender and technology highlighted the need for support networks and referral mechanisms for women journalists facing harassment, as well as strengthening the independence of federal and Sindh commissions for the protection of journalists to combat impunity.

Diplomats from European Union member states addressed the conference to reaffirm support for independent media. German Ambassador Ina Lepel noted that press freedom remains incomplete if half the population faces barriers, stressing the necessity of women's safety in expression. French Ambassador Jean-Noel Poirier underscored that disinformation must be fought with reliable facts rather than censorship, while ensuring artificial intelligence supports journalism. Netherlands Ambassador Robert-Jan Siegert highlighted the alarming global statistic that nearly nine out of ten journalist killings remain unresolved, condemning the prevailing culture of impunity.

The conference featured multiple panel discussions and working sessions addressing digital rights, impunity mechanisms, and media economics. A report published by Freedom Network on May 2, 2026, titled “Regulatory Repression of Freedom of Expression,” documented at least 129 violations and warned that the amended PECA has increasingly been utilized to criminalize lawful expression, target political dissent, and intimidate media practitioners in Pakistan.

stories.title: انڈین ری میک میں لوک گیت 'سمی میری وار' کی شناخت پر تنازع
stories.summary:
پاکستان کا مقبول پنجابی لوک گیت 'سمی میری وار' ایک بار پھر سوشل میڈیا پر بحث کا مرکز بن گیا ہے، بالخصوص جب میوزک کمپنی ٹی سیریز نے تلسی کمار کی آواز میں اس کا نیا ورژن جاری کیا۔ ناقدین اور سوشل میڈیا صارفین کی جانب سے اس بات پر اعتراض کیا جا رہا ہے کہ گانے کے کریڈٹس میں اسے صرف 'روایتی' لکھا گیا ہے اور اس کی پاکستانی لوک روایت یا جدید شناخت بحال کرنے والے فنکاروں کا ذکر نہیں کیا گیا۔

اس لوک گیت کو عالمی سطح پر نئی پہچان 2015 میں کوک سٹوڈیو پاکستان میں قرت العین بلوچ اور عمیر جسوال کی پیشکش سے ملی تھی، جبکہ 2026 میں شانزے سیال کے کور ورژن نے بھی اسے مقبول کیا۔ سوشل میڈیا پر صارفین نے اس بات پر زور دیا ہے کہ اس گانے کی جڑیں پاکستانی پنجاب کے تاریخی خطے سندل بار سے جڑی ہیں، اس لیے اس کے ثقافتی پس منظر کا اعتراف کیا جانا چاہیے۔

دوسری جانب کچھ صارفین کا کہنا ہے کہ یہ گیت پاکستان کے قیام سے بھی پہلے کا ہے اور اسے کسی ایک ملک کی ملکیت قرار نہیں دیا جا سکتا، بلکہ سرحد پار اس کی بازگشت کو ثقافتی تبادلے کا حصہ سمجھنا چاہیے۔ اس پوری بحث نے دونوں ممالک کے شائقین کو ایک مشترکہ موسیقی کے موضوع پر گفتگو کرنے کا موقع فراہم کیا ہے۔

یہ تنازع اس لیے اہم ہے کہ یہ ثقافتی ورثے کے تحفظ، دانشورانہ حقوق اور سرحدوں سے ماورا آرٹ کی شناخت کے مباحث کو ہوا دیتا ہے۔ یہ ظاہر کرتا ہے کہ ثقافتی اثاثے دونوں اطراف کے لوگوں کے لیے کتنی گہری جذباتی اہمیت رکھتے ہیں۔

stories.title: Twelve Bangladeshi Cricketers Register For Upcoming IPL Mini Auction
stories.summary:
Organisers reported on Wednesday that twelve cricketers from Bangladesh have officially registered for the upcoming Indian Premier League auction scheduled for next month. These players are included in the initial roster of 1,220 candidates for the December 16 mini auction in Goa, though the pool will be narrowed down before franchises make their final picks, according to the Board of Control for Cricket in India. The BCCI noted that with 184 athletes already retained or selected by teams ahead of the event, a maximum of 66 slots, including 25 overseas positions, remain open.

This development occurs despite tense political relations between India and Bangladesh. Bangladesh was previously excluded from the Twenty20 World Cup co-hosted by India following a refusal to play matches on Indian soil due to security concerns. That incident followed an order by the BCCI instructing the Kolkata Knight Riders to drop Bangladeshi fast bowler Mustafizur Rahman despite a purchase of over $1 million during the previous year's auction. Those events coincided with online demonstrations by right-wing groups in India referencing alleged violence against Hindus in Muslim-majority Bangladesh, while Dhaka asserted that Indian media exaggerated the scale of those incidents.

Bilateral ties have worsened significantly following a 2024 mass uprising in Bangladesh that removed former prime minister Sheikh Hasina, a close ally of New Delhi who is currently living in exile in India. Meanwhile, the broader IPL registration list features high-profile figures such as England all-rounder Ben Stokes with a base price of $216,900. Indian players form the majority of the initial pool with 939 entries, while Australia leads the international contingent with 53 players, followed by South Africa, the West Indies, New Zealand, and Afghanistan. Emerging cricket nations are also represented, including thirteen registrations from the United States and ten each from Nepal and the United Arab Emirates.

stories.title: Prime Minister Commends Climate Minister For SCO Civilizational Dialogue
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif met with Minister for Climate Change Musadik Malik in Islamabad to commend his diplomatic efforts. The Prime Minister praised Malik for representing Pakistan effectively during the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilizational Dialogue held in Delhi.

During the meeting, the Prime Minister highlighted that Malik accurately conveyed historical contexts and ground realities during the regional dialogue. Furthermore, Sharif commended Malik's eloquence, proficiency in the Urdu language, and his ability to communicate complex matters clearly.

Sharif stated that Malik established a new benchmark for diplomatic engagement through his intellectual clarity and patience. According to the Prime Minister, these qualities successfully contributed to projecting a positive image of Pakistan throughout the region.

The interaction underscores the government's recognition of ministerial performance in international forums. No further details regarding the discussions were mentioned in the official reports.

stories.title: Asian Development Bank Approves $250 Million Loan to Boost Pakistan Public-Private Partnerships
stories.summary:
The Asian Development Bank (ADB) announced on Wednesday the approval of a $250 million policy-based loan designed to assist Pakistan in strengthening its public-private partnership (PPP) system. The financing aims to advance a pipeline of bankable, sustainable projects capable of attracting private capital and driving economic growth. According to the Manila-based lending agency, the funds will support governmental reforms focused on preparing market-ready infrastructure projects and improving fiscal risk management.

ADB Country Director for Pakistan Emma Fan stated that rigorous project appraisal, transparent disclosure, and sound fiscal management are vital for translating Pakistan's PPP pipeline into sustainable infrastructure investments. This initiative represents the second phase of the 'Promoting Sustainable Public-Private Partnerships Programme,' building on the first phase launched in 2024 that established legal and policy frameworks for PPPs. Under the current phase, the Pakistani government has consolidated federal PPP and privatisation functions under a unified platform, established dedicated PPP units across four line ministries and agencies, and created a national framework to monitor and disclose fiscal liabilities.

Additionally, the government approved a medium-term PPP pipeline for the 2026-2030 period with ADB backing. A new 'National PPP and Investment Knowledge Hub' will offer training and tools to federal and provincial institutions, supporting peer learning and capacity building. The programme incorporates resilience and inclusivity into planning and procurement, bolstered by $1.1 million in technical assistance from the ADB's Technical Assistance Special Fund and $950,000 from the Asia Pacific Project Preparation Facility.

This approval follows recent ADB financial activities in Pakistan, including an undisclosed investment in local B2B fintech company Neem announced on Monday. Earlier in September, Pakistan also requested scaled-up ADB financing for public-private partnerships, which includes the $10 billion Karachi-Peshawar Main Railway Line project. These measures underscore ongoing international support for Pakistan's public investment and structural reform agenda.

stories.title: Pakistan President Zardari Urges Closer Ties and Defence Cooperation with Bangladesh
stories.summary:
President Asif Ali Zardari met with a visiting Bangladeshi parliamentary delegation in Islamabad on Wednesday to discuss ways to enhance bilateral relations. The delegation was led by Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmad Bir Bikram, and the meeting took place at the President House. Zardari emphasized that Islamabad places great importance on its connection with Dhaka, which he noted is built upon shared history, common faith, and deep cultural and familial ties.

During the discussions, the two sides explored various areas for expanded collaboration, including trade, economics, education, and people-to-people interactions. Zardari highlighted the potential for joint efforts in agriculture, industry, food security, disaster management, digital governance, space research, and defence. He confirmed that Pakistan is prepared to offer defence cooperation and assist in providing technical expertise to refurbish sugar plants following a request from Bangladesh. Furthermore, he pointed to the ongoing export of Pakistani rice under a government-to-government agreement as a foundation for broader food security cooperation.

The talks also touched upon institutional frameworks, with Zardari expressing hope for the swift finalization of roughly 26 memorandums of understanding currently under review. He congratulated Bangladesh on the election of Barrister Adib Chowdhury, chairman of the Parliamentary Foreign Affairs Committee, to the Inter-Parliamentary Union Executive Committee. Additionally, Zardari welcomed the establishment of a Pakistan-Bangladesh Parliamentary Friendship Group and offered training assistance for Bangladeshi parliamentary officials at the Pakistan Institute for Parliamentary Services.

Education and regional connectivity were major focal points of the meeting. Zardari mentioned the Pakistan-Bangladesh Knowledge Corridor, established the previous year, which grants 500 fully funded scholarships to Bangladeshi students, noting that 170 students have already enrolled in Pakistani universities with another 20 expected soon. He also noted the commencement of direct flights by Biman Bangladesh Airlines and advocated for increased flight frequency, additional destinations, and direct maritime links to boost commerce.

Concluding the meeting, Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmad expressed gratitude for the hospitality shown to his delegation and delivered greetings from Bangladesh President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir and Prime Minister Tarique Rahman. Ahmad emphasized the value of parliamentary diplomacy and noted the widespread popularity of Pakistani television dramas in Bangladesh as evidence of the strong cultural connection between the two populations. Zardari additionally commended Bangladesh for hosting over one million Rohingya refugees and reaffirmed Pakistan's support for their safe and dignified return to Myanmar.

stories.title: Maldives And Pakistan Agree To Expand Bilateral Ties And Launch Flights
stories.summary:
Pakistan and the Maldives have formally agreed to broaden their bilateral cooperation across multiple sectors, including tourism, health, trade, sports, and manpower. The agreement was reached during a meeting in Islamabad involving Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, Minister of State Talal Chaudhry, and Maldivian Minister of Tourism and Civil Aviation Mohamed Ameen.

During the discussions, Naqvi noted that Islamabad possesses substantial potential to serve as a tourism capital. Ameen announced plans for the national airline of the Maldives to initiate direct flights connecting Pakistan and the Maldivian islands, a move designed to simplify travel for Pakistani citizens. Naqvi emphasized that the new air links would increase the flow of Pakistani tourists to the Maldives, mentioning that prominent Pakistani artists, celebrities, and cricket stars intend to travel on the inaugural direct flight. Ameen concurred that popular Pakistani public figures visiting the island nation would significantly support tourism promotion.

In addition to tourism and aviation initiatives, Naqvi shared that the Pakistan Cricket Board is currently formulating a project to construct a cricket academy and stadium in the Maldives to offer improved training facilities for local youth. Addressing economic cooperation, Ameen stated that the Maldives requires additional workforce and would enthusiastically welcome workers from Pakistan. He also pointed out extensive commercial opportunities for importing construction supplies, pharmaceutical products, and other commodities from Pakistan.

stories.title: FIFA Presidential Hopeful Kozo Tashima Pledges Single Term If Elected
stories.summary:
FIFA presidential candidate Kozo Tashima announced on Wednesday that he intends to limit his tenure to a single four-year term if he defeats current president Gianni Infantino and French football leader Philippe Diallo in the upcoming March election. Tashima, representing Japan, has committed to restoring integrity and transparency to world football's governing body, positioning himself as one of three contenders on the ballot.

Infantino faces substantial criticism over a controversial and ultimately aborted proposal to permit private investment into the World Cup, yet he maintains robust backing for his bid to secure a fourth and final term. Acknowledging that his prospects of winning are relatively slim, the 69-year-old Tashima outlined his brief agenda to reporters in Tokyo, emphasizing that his four-year focus would center entirely on overhauling governance and making internal administrative processes within FIFA more transparent.

Tashima previously stated that he was not considering withdrawing from the race to clear a direct path for Diallo to challenge Infantino. Diallo currently holds the backing of Europe and is widely viewed as the more formidable challenger to unseat the incumbent president. Tashima confirmed he has spoken with Diallo via telephone and plans an in-person meeting in Europe to discuss tactical alignment.

While noting that he and Diallo share a similar overarching direction, Tashima indicated that further communication would determine whether their strategies completely align or retain distinct differences. Ultimately, Tashima stressed that their primary objective is returning FIFA to the proper course, utilizing various tactical options to reach that goal.

stories.title: کالعدم بلوچ لبریشن آرمی نے رحمان گل کو نیا کمانڈر انچیف مقرر کر دیا
stories.summary:
رواں ماہ کے آغاز میں کالعدم عسکریت پسند تنظیم بلوچ لبریشن آرمی نے اعلان کیا کہ بشیر زیب اب تنظیم کے سربراہ نہیں رہے ہیں۔ اس اعلان کے چند روز بعد رحمان گل عرف مرید کو تنظیم کا نیا کمانڈر انچیف مقرر کرنے کا باضابطہ اعلان کیا گیا، جس کے بعد رحمان گل اس تنظیم کے چھٹے سربراہ بن گئے ہیں۔

بی ایل اے کی بنیاد 1970 کی دہائی میں رکھی گئی تھی اور وقت کے ساتھ اس کی قیادت میں کئی تبدیلیاں آئیں۔ نواب خیر بخش مری، بالاچ مری، حربیار مری، اور استاد اسلم بلوچ کے بعد سنہ 2018 میں بشیر زیب اس تنظیم کے سربراہ بنے تھے اور لگ بھگ آٹھ سال تک اس عہدے پر فائز رہے، جن کے دور میں تنظیم نے کراچی قونصل خانے اور گوادر کے ہوٹل سمیت کئی بڑے حملوں کی ذمہ داری قبول کی۔

تنظیم کے ترجمان جیئند بلوچ نے اس تبدیلی کو ایک معمول کی داخلی منتقلی اور ادارہ جاتی عمل قرار دیا ہے، تاہم یہ واضح نہیں کیا گیا کہ بشیر زیب کا مستقبل کا کردار کیا ہوگا۔ دوسری جانب سکیورٹی تجزیہ کاروں اور ماہرین کا کہنا ہے کہ اس تبدیلی کے پس منظر میں ریاستی دباؤ، تنظیمی ساخت، اندرونی اختلافات اور حال ہی میں ہونے والے بھاری جانی نقصانات جیسے عوامل بھی کارفرما ہو سکتے ہیں۔

ماہرین کے مطابق یہ دیکھنا باقی ہے کہ رحمان گل کی قیادت میں تنظیم اپنی سابقہ حکمت عملی برقرار رکھتی ہے یا اس میں کوئی نمایاں تبدیلی لاتی ہے۔ پاکستان، برطانیہ اور امریکہ سمیت کئی ممالک اس تنظیم کو دہشت گرد قرار دے چکے ہیں جبکہ بلوچستان میں شورش ایک بار پھر قومی سطح پر توجہ کا مرکز بنی ہوئی ہے۔

stories.title: Four Pakistani cueists advance to the IBSF Men's World Cup quarter-finals
stories.summary:
Four prominent Pakistani cueists successfully advanced to the quarter-finals of the IBSF Men’s World Cup 2026 after securing dominant victories in the pre-quarterfinal round in Oman.
